tools.description: Find recent Messages chats by participant, chat name, date range, or unread status. When multiple participants are provided, every participant must belong to the chat. Returns each chat's unread_count and stable chat_guid for reuse with read_messages, search_messages, send_message, and count_message_activity. Within each response, each chats[].participants item references a participants[].local_ref.

exact_participants.description: When true, requires participants and matches only chats containing exactly those participants. When false, chats may include additional participants.

from.description: Include messages at or after this ISO-8601 date-time.

name.description: Exact or partial chat name, such as a named group chat.

participants.description: Names, phone numbers, or email addresses that must all participate in the chat. Names are resolved using macOS Contacts.

to.description: Include messages before this ISO-8601 date-time.

unread_only.description: When true, return only chats with unread messages.

tools.name: find_chats

has_more.description: Whether additional matching chats exist beyond those returned.

tools.description: Read messages from one exact chat, newest first. If the intended chat's chat_guid is already available, use it directly. This tool returns one page of messages at a time. When more messages are available, the response includes next_cursor; pass that value as cursor in the next read_messages call. Within each response, each messages[].chat references a chats[].local_ref, and each messages[].sender references a senders[].local_ref or is me (the current user) or unknown; do not reuse local_ref mappings across responses. Messages may include attachment metadata, but not attachment contents. Unread messages include is_unread: true.

chat_guid.description: The stable chat_guid of the chat.

cursor.description: The next_cursor returned by the preceding read_messages response. Use it unchanged to read the next page, with the same chat_guid, from, to, and unread_only values.

from.description: Include messages at or after this ISO-8601 date-time.

to.description: Include messages before this ISO-8601 date-time.

unread_only.description: When true, return only unread messages.

tools.name: read_messages

tools.description: Search message-body text, newest first. Narrow large histories with chat_guids, participants, or ISO-8601 date filters. This tool returns one page of messages at a time. When more messages are available, the response includes next_cursor; pass that value as cursor in the next search_messages call. Each response's chats[] items include a stable chat_guid for reuse with read_messages and send_message. Within each response, each messages[].chat references a chats[].local_ref, and each messages[].sender references a senders[].local_ref or is me (the current user) or unknown; do not reuse local_ref mappings across responses. Messages may include attachment metadata, but not attachment contents. Unread messages include is_unread: true.

chat_guids.description: Optional stable chat_guid values for existing chats. When provided, searches only those chats.

cursor.description: The next_cursor returned by the preceding search_messages response. Use it unchanged to retrieve the next page, with the same text, chat_guids, participants, exact_participants, from, and to values.

exact_participants.description: When true, requires participants and matches only chats containing exactly those participants. When false, chats may include additional participants.

from.description: Include messages at or after this ISO-8601 date-time.

participants.description: Optional names, phone numbers, or email addresses that must all participate in matched chats. Names are resolved using macOS Contacts.

text.description: Case-insensitive text to find in message bodies.

to.description: Include messages before this ISO-8601 date-time.

tools.name: search_messages

permission_filter_message.description: Present only when permission_filtered is true. Explains why messages were omitted from this page.

permission_filtered.description: Present and true only when read permissions caused messages to be omitted from this page; absent otherwise. The page may contain fewer messages than the requested limit, including none, and still have a next_cursor.

tools.description: Send text, local file attachments, or both. Provide exactly one of chat_guid or recipients. The user may edit the message before approving, indicated by user_edited. Reactions, edits, and unsends are unsupported; use the Computer Use plugin for those UI operations.

attachments.description: Optional absolute paths to local files to attach. Directories are unsupported.

chat_guid.description: The stable chat_guid of an existing direct or group chat.

recipients.description: One or more names, phone numbers, or email addresses. One recipient targets a direct chat; multiple recipients target an existing chat with exactly those participants or a new group chat.

tools.name: send_message

tools.description: Count Messages activity over time, either overall or per chat. Returns total message counts split into sent and received, optionally grouped by calendar interval. When the request names specific chats or people, first resolve the intended chats with find_chats, then pass the returned chat_guid values as chat_guids. Set breakdown to overall for combined activity or chat for ranked per-chat activity. When more chats are available, the response includes next_cursor; pass that value as cursor in the next count_message_activity call with the original filter arguments. If from or to was originally omitted, continue omitting it. Every counts_by_bucket object contains total, sent, and received arrays aligned by index with buckets, including intervals with no activity.

breakdown.description: Return combined overall activity or ranked, paginated per-chat activity.

chat_guids.description: Optional stable chat_guid values for existing chats. When provided, counts only those chats.

chat_limit.description: For chat breakdowns, sets the maximum number of chats per page; defaults to 20.

chat_type.description: Optional chat type filter. Omit to include both direct and group chats.

cursor.description: The next_cursor returned by the preceding count_message_activity response. Use it unchanged to retrieve the next chat page, with the same from, to, interval, chat_type, chat_guids, breakdown, and rank_by values.

from.description: Include activity at or after this ISO-8601 date-time. Omit to begin at the oldest matching activity.

interval.description: Calendar interval for buckets. total returns one bucket for a nonempty range; weeks begin Monday.

rank_by.description: For chat breakdowns, rank chats by total, sent, or received message count; defaults to total.

to.description: Include activity before this ISO-8601 date-time. Omit to end at the first request's current time.

tools.name: count_message_activity

buckets.description: Shared ordered half-open intervals aligned by index with every array in counts_by_bucket.

interval.description: Calendar interval used for the shared buckets array.

matching_chat_count.description: Exact number of chats with counted activity in the complete filtered range, not only this page.

overall_activity.description: Complete aggregate across every matching chat in the filtered range.

received.description: Received message counts aligned by index with the top-level buckets array.

sent.description: Sent message counts aligned by index with the top-level buckets array.

total.description: Total message counts aligned by index with the top-level buckets array.

received.description: Messages received by the current user.

sent.description: Messages sent by the current user.

range.description: The resolved complete half-open range. Omitted request bounds resolve to the oldest matching activity and the first page's request-start time, then remain frozen across continuation pages.

time_zone.description: Time zone used for calendar bucket boundaries.

buckets.description: Shared ordered half-open intervals aligned by index with every array in counts_by_bucket.

chats.description: The current ranked page of matching chats.

received.description: Received message counts aligned by index with the top-level buckets array.

sent.description: Sent message counts aligned by index with the top-level buckets array.

total.description: Total message counts aligned by index with the top-level buckets array.

participants.description: Page-local references to top-level participants[].local_ref values.

received.description: Messages received by the current user.

sent.description: Messages sent by the current user.

interval.description: Calendar interval used for the shared buckets array.

matching_chat_count.description: Exact number of chats with counted activity in the complete filtered range, not only this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the next ranked chat page. Omitted on the final page.

participants.description: Participants referenced by chats in this page only.

range.description: The resolved complete half-open range. Omitted request bounds resolve to the oldest matching activity and the first page's request-start time, then remain frozen across continuation pages.

time_zone.description: Time zone used for calendar bucket boundaries.

tools.description: Read an image attachment returned by read_messages or search_messages. Returns the image, which may be resized or compressed to limit transfer size.

id.description: The id from an attachment object returned by read_messages or search_messages.
